message.content:
The **bar fall** scene is in **“Yuppy Love”**, the **first episode of Series 6** of *Only Fools and Horses*.[2][1] It is the moment where **Del Boy falls through the open bar flap**, which became one of the show’s most famous scenes.[1][3]

If you meant the specific clip, it is often described as **“Del Boy falls through the bar”** and is associated with **Del and Trigger** in that episode.[2]
